decision.explanation: The source documents provide two distinct awards received by 'Advances in Meteorology'. Document 1 (D1S1, D1S2) explicitly states the journal earned the 'DOAJ Seal of Approval' (also referred to as 'DOAJ seal'). Document 2 (D2S3) describes the journal receiving the 'Belisario Domínguez Medal of Honor', accepted on behalf of the team. Both are valid, distinct awards mentioned in the text, satisfying the request for all supported answers without contradiction.
